workbench_first_attempt.page_title: 服务事件复核与风险排序 — Weave Workbench
subsequent_behavior: attempted a non-public localhost web fetch
searched source files for a team list interface
searched broad filesystem paths until stopped
workbench_first_attempt.stop_reason: The frozen first-result rule forbids correcting the team identifier or allowing unrelated host search to continue.

database_observation.finding: No TeamRun, run snapshot, delivery binding, or delivery verification was created for the held-out team.

root_cause.finding: Workbench reasoning selects a team by its human display name, while weave_dispatch requires the exact opaque team ID. The exposed tool set provides no bounded authoritative team discovery or name-to-ID resolution path.
root_cause.repeated_prior_signal: The Corona v3 path also required an operator-supplied exact team UUID after a natural-name dispatch failed.
root_cause.contract_mechanism_assessment: The published contract exists on the frozen workflow, but this sample cannot judge run-time contract inheritance because admission was never reached.

proves: a newly built active team was not naturally dispatchable by its visible name
the first cold-start attempt created no TeamRun
the current fallback behavior searches the host instead of returning a bounded recovery path
does_not_prove: that the published delivery contract would fail after a valid dispatch
that the task members or arithmetic would fail
that the overall Weave business loop is complete
